text:
ryan (PM): Starting a PRD thread for Dedicated Capacity SLA + autoscale. Need to lock acceptance criteria, throughput sizing methodology, and a short list of edge cases to validate before launch. Who can help triage?

anya (Eng Lead): I can take a pass on the sizing methodology. High level: define traffic profiles, set target SLOs per profile, and map to pool configs (GPUs, batch size).

sergio (SRE): +1. Also define error budget, rollback thresholds, and automatic fallback to hosted models. We should be explicit about degraded-mode behavior.

maria (Product): Customers want 99.9% availability and predictable tail latency. We should capture both availability SLA and a few latency bands for typical model classes.

jun (QA): I'll own acceptance tests and chaos scenarios. Need clear pass/fail for autoscale behavior under spike and slow drain on scale-in.

ryan (PM): Proposed SLOs (draft):
- Availability: 99.95% monthly for Dedicated control plane + serving lane
- Latency (interactive gen): p95 < 200ms, p99 < 400ms for short contexts (<=512 tokens) on smallish models (<=13B).
